name: Microsoft Photos
summary: The photo and video app built into Windows: a Gallery timeline across PC folders, OneDrive and iCloud, a fast viewer that pages through a folder, and an editor with AI tools. Good for casual browsing and quick edits; Photos Legacy keeps the older video editor and slideshow maker. No archives, no file-manager features.
where_it_wins: OneDrive and iCloud photos in one Gallery
AI editing: object removal, Relight, super resolution on Copilot+ PCs
People, Albums, Moments and natural-language search
where_schnellbild_wins: Folder browser with folder previews, list view, regex search
Plays MKV, WebM, AVI, FLV through VLC with subtitles and audio track choice
No account or cloud, never goes online
